description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering employee reports within the OrangeHRM system's time plugin. It extends a date range filter and adds specific fields such as employee number, project ID, activity ID, and timesheet inclusion options, along with related getter and setter methods.

classes.name: EmployeeReportsSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class used for searching and filtering employee reports based on various parameters such as employee number, project, activity, and timesheet status. It includes predefined constants for allowed sort fields and timesheet inclusion options, and extends a base date range filter class.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number for which the report is generated.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the report filter.

methods.name: getProjectId
methods.description: Retrieves the project ID associated with the report filter.

methods.name: setProjectId
methods.description: Sets the project ID for filtering.

methods.name: getActivityId
methods.description: Retrieves the activity ID associated with the report filter.

methods.name: setActivityId
methods.description: Sets the activity ID for filtering.

methods.name: getIncludeTimesheets
methods.description: Retrieves the current setting for including timesheets in the report.

methods.name: setIncludeTimesheets
methods.description: Sets whether to include only approved timesheets or all, validating input against predefined options.
